```yaml
name: CI (Linux System Libs)

on:
  push:
    paths:
      - '.github/workflows/build_linux_systemlibs.yml'
  release:
    types: [published]
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout repository
      uses: actions/checkout@v2

    - name: Set up Python
      uses: actions/setup-python@v2
      with:
        python-version: '3.x'

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        sudo apt-get update
        sudo apt-get install -y build-essential cmake libavcodec-dev libavformat-dev libswscale-dev libass-dev libfreetype6-dev libfontconfig1-dev libxml2-dev libxslt1-dev libssl-dev

    - name: Build basic variant
      run: |
        mkdir build_basic && cd build_basic
        cmake .. -DCCX_SYSTEM_LIBS=ON
        make

    - name: Build hardsubx variant
      run: |
        mkdir build_hardsubx && cd build_hardsubx
        cmake .. -DCCX_SYSTEM_LIBS=ON -DCCX_HARDSUBX=ON
        make

    - name: Check binary linking
      run: |
        ldd ./build_basic/ccextractor | grep "not found"
        ldd ./build_hardsubx/ccextractor | grep "not found"

    - name: Upload artifacts
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@v2
      with:
        name: ccextractor-binaries
        path: './build_basic/ccextractor,./build_hardsubx/ccextractor'
```
